name: Securities Transaction Cancellation Request V 09
definition: Scope|An account owner sends a SecuritiesTransactionCancellationRequest to an account servicer to request the cancellation of a securities transaction.|The account owner/servicer relationship may be:|- a global custodian which has an account with a local custodian, or|- an investment management institution which manage a fund account opened at a custodian, or - a broker which has an account with a custodian, or|- a central securities depository participant which has an account with a central securities depository, or|- a central securities depository which has an account with a custodian, another central securities depository or another settlement market infrastructure, or|- a central counterparty or a stock exchange or a trade matching utility which need to instruct to a central securities depository or another settlement market infrastructure.||Usage|The transaction may be:|- a securities settlement transaction|- an intra-position movement|- a securities financing transaction|The instruction cannot be:|- a securities settlement conditions modification (another transaction processing command should be sent to reverse a processing change previously requested).|- a securities financing modification|The message may also be used to:|- re-send a message previously sent,|- provide a third party with a copy of a message for information,|- re-send to a third party a copy of a message for information using the relevant elements in the Business Application Header.

AccountOwnerTransactionIdentification.name: Account Owner Transaction Identification
AccountOwnerTransactionIdentification.definition: Unambiguous identification of the transaction as known by the account owner (or the instructing party managing the account).

AccountServicerTransactionIdentification.name: Account Servicer Transaction Identification
AccountServicerTransactionIdentification.definition: Unambiguous identification of the transaction as known by the account servicer.

MarketInfrastructureTransactionIdentific.name: Market Infrastructure Transaction Identification
MarketInfrastructureTransactionIdentific.definition: Identification of a transaction assigned by a market infrastructure other than a central securities depository, for example, Target2-Securities.

ProcessorTransactionIdentification.name: Processor Transaction Identification
ProcessorTransactionIdentification.definition: Message Reference identifying the Processor of the transaction.

NonceIdentification.name: Nonce Identification
NonceIdentification.definition: Unambiguous identification of a random or semi-random number used once (NONCE) generated in the frame of a cryptographic communication.

AccountOwner.name: Account Owner
AccountOwner.definition: Party that legally owns the account.

SafekeepingAccount.name: Safekeeping Account
SafekeepingAccount.definition: Account to or from which a securities entry is made.

BlockChainAddressOrWallet.name: Block Chain Address Or Wallet
BlockChainAddressOrWallet.definition: Blockchain address or wallet where digital assets are maintained. This is the equivalent of safekeeping account for digital assets.

TransactionDetails.name: Transaction Details
TransactionDetails.definition: Identifies the details of the transaction.

CancellationReason.name: Cancellation Reason
CancellationReason.definition: Specifies the reason of the cancellation.

FXCancellation.name: FX Cancellation
FXCancellation.definition: Specifies whether an associated FX should be cancelled.

SupplementaryData.name: Supplementary Data
SupplementaryData.definition: Additional information that cannot be captured in the structured elements and/or any other specific block.

TransactionIdentificationPresence2Rule.definition: If AccountOwnerTransactionIdentification is NONREF then at least one of the other references must be present.

NoAccountOwnerTransactionIdentificationR.definition: If no reference is available for the AccountOwnerTransactionIdentification, then the AccountOwnerTransactionIdentification must be NONREF.

SafekeepingAccountOrBlockChainAddress1Ru.definition: If SafekeepingAccount is present, BlockChainAddressOrWallet must be absent.

SafekeepingAccountOrBlockChainAddress2Ru.definition: If BlockChainAddressOrWallet is present, SafekeepingAccount must be absent.

SafekeepingAccountOrBlockChainAddress3Ru.definition: Either SafekeepingAccount or BlockChainAddressOrWallet must be present but not both.
